en: A sepia-toned landscape view showing grassy hills with the ruins of a stone fortress on the ridge and a white church with a tall steeple on the right. Below the hill is a river crossed by a small bridge, and in the foreground stands a solitary wooden house surrounded by trees and fields. The image has wide margins and the aesthetic of an early 20th‑century postcard photograph. No printed or handwritten text is visible on the image side.
